chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Ali, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
It is recommended to perform Tawaf around the House (Kaaba) for the number of days of the year, with each week consisting of seven days; that is fifty-two weeks.

key_terms.أُسْبُوعاً: Weeks - units of seven days used here to structure the annual ritual
key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: The House - referring to the Kaaba in Mecca
key_terms.يُسْتَحَبُّ: Recommended (Mustahabb) - a legal ruling indicating a rewarded but not obligatory act
key_terms.يُطَافَ: To perform Tawaf - the ritual circumambulation of the Kaaba

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended schedule for performing Tawaf around the Kaaba according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on expiation for the pilgrim, this hadith highlights the virtue of consistent, voluntary circumambulation (Tawaf) as a means of spiritual devotion. By prescribing fifty-two circuits—corresponding to the weeks of the year—it encourages a rhythm of worship that integrates the sacred space of the Kaaba into the believer's annual cycle, reinforcing the concept of *Ibadah* as a continuous, structured practice.
